note: Cross-repo contract for the entitlement push. This file is duplicated byte-for-byte in work-address/app and work-address/web; they are separate repositories, so each owns a copy. web asserts it PRODUCES these bytes and this signature; app asserts it ACCEPTS them. Changing one without the other breaks entitlement in production in a way neither suite would otherwise catch, so change both in the same pull request or not at all.
